faq.a: Husaina is associated with the Arabic form حُسَيْنَة, whose core sense is husaina; diminutive of husna (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Husaina?
faq.a: Husaina is associated with Arabic. Husaina is Arabic حُسَيْنَة (Ḥusayna), the feminine diminutive of حَسَن, meaning 'good'.
Yes — the underlying form حُسَيْنَة is Arabic.
Husaina can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Husaina should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥusayna is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Husaina mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Husaina is rendered حسینہ and carries the sense حسینہ، اچھی.

faq.q: What does Husaina mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Husaina is rendered حسینه and carries the sense حسینه، نیکو.
A romanized syllable approximation is hu-sai-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Husaina?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Husaina, husaina. Script forms are حسينه, حسینه, حسینہ, حُسَيْنَة, हुसैना.

faq.q: Is Husaina a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
